REWARD TRACKER

Build your wallet from the card catalog, tick off statement credits as you use them, and watch one HUD answer the only question that matters: are your rewards beating your annual fees?

🔒Your data stays in your browser on this device. It is never uploaded or shared. No account, no sign-up — clearing your browser data clears this tracker.

Never enter a card number here. Reward Tracker has no field for card numbers, CVVs, or bank logins — and it never will. It only tracks annual fees, benefits, rewards credits, and expiry reminders for cards you already own.

My Wallet

Tap a card to expand it — value math, benefits, protections, and credits grouped by how fast they expire. Tick each credit when you've used it.

Add a Card

Tap a card to drop it into your wallet — fee, credits, earn rates and protections come pre-filled. Don't see yours? Build a custom card at the end.

How it works: cards start minimized — tap to expand. Monthly credits reset on the 1st, half-year credits reset Jan 1 and Jul 1, and annual credits reset on your card anniversary (set the month your fee posts and the radar counts them down). “Value captured” counts only what you tick; nothing here is guessed or pulled from a bank.
Safety: this page never asks for — and has nowhere to type — a card number, CVV, PIN, or bank password. If any page ever asks you to type those into a tracker like this, close it.
Accuracy: catalog fees, credits, earn rates and protections are the cards' publicly listed terms; issuers change them, so check your issuer's benefits guide for the final word.
Privacy: everything you enter is stored only in this browser's local storage on this device. No account, no server — the page owner and other visitors can't see your wallet.
